notes.en: Reserved events are not emitted or available to automation in this host. Layout regions are additionally declared by the active layout. Technical media state remains host-owned.
notes.zh-CN: 预留事件尚未由当前宿主发出，不能绑定自动化规则。启用的布局还会声明其他区域。真实媒体状态由宿主管理。

requirementHelp.zh-CN: 整数，最小值为 1，最大值为 2–100。请先在基本信息中设置范围。
requirementHelp.en: Requires integers starting at 1, maximum 2–100. Set the range in Basics first.

refresh.description: Automatic enrichment policy. "missing" (default) consults the source only while a field it fills is empty; "always" consults it on every automatic run. Explicit requests always run.

imagePresentation.description: Result of ui.identity.*.primaryImagePresentation: a registered imagePresentations entry and its parameters. Hosts fill parameter defaults; any other result shows the whole image.

view.description: 3d: a case turned slightly to show the front cover and part of the spine, turning to the back cover on hover. front/back: only that cover, flat.

spine.description: Spine width as a fraction of the image width. The image is laid out back | spine | front from left to right; the covers share the rest equally.

description.zh-CN: 先声明值类型与约束，再从兼容组件中选择录入方式。切换组件不改变取值规则。
description.en: Define value type and constraints first, then choose a compatible input. Changing a component never changes the value contract.

description.zh-CN: 按图片自身的宽高比完整展示；列表中各卡片高度相同，宽度随图片比例变化。
description.en: Shows the whole image at its own aspect ratio; list cards share one height and take their width from the image.

description.zh-CN: 把图片当作从左到右为“封底 | 中脊 | 封面”的包装盒展开图，展示为立体包装盒，或只平面展示封面、封底。
description.en: Treats the image as an unfolded case laid out back | spine | front from left to right, shown as a 3D case or as one flat cover.
